naming.name: Sazorin Starjourney
naming.lore: Sunveil lineages carry new star names and remedies home from their travels. Astronomers, porters and healers share registers without fixing a child’s calling.

world.name: The Quiet Downs

locations.name: Ironpass
locations.description: A small settlement of hearth fires, kitchen gardens, and familiar faces. Ashfall fever has reached its households; the old shrine is still a place to seek help.  At dusk, the baker leaves the last loaf on the wall for whoever returns late. Children learn the safe paths before they learn the toll roads. Current public magic law: licensed; an accusation still requires a local witness or evidence.
locations.localCustom: Children learn the safe paths before they learn the toll roads.

institutions.name: Ironpass Wren Shrine
institutions.history: Its public record names the households that maintained this place, including neighbors outside the wealthy guilds.

locations.name: Ironhall
locations.description: The region’s busy city gathers an academy, a guild market, and a sworn order behind its stone walls. Fever wards are filling, and scholars disagree over the cause.  On wash days, apprentices carry dyed cloth across the square; the Ironpass carts wait until it dries. A door painted with a reed offers water to travelers. Current public magic law: permitted; an accusation still requires a local witness or evidence.
locations.localCustom: A door painted with a reed offers water to travelers.

locations.name: Copperdelve
locations.description: A riverside village where millers, ferrymen, and herbalists trade news. Families are sheltering travelers fleeing Ashfall fever.  The well cover bears the names of three households, though only two remain on this road. Guests leave a small candle at the public hearth. Current public magic law: permitted; an accusation still requires a local witness or evidence.

locations.name: The Willow path Thicket
locations.description: Old trails connect both villages beneath a canopy of moss and copper leaves. Healing herbs grow here, alongside hungry beasts and abandoned camps. The nearest settlement’s law governs witnessed acts. The trees lean away from a clearing where no birds settle before sunrise. Guests leave a small candle at the public hearth. Current public magic law: permitted; an accusation still requires a local witness or evidence.

institutions.history: Its public record names the households that maintained this place, including neighbors outside the wealthy guilds.

locations.name: The Basaltanvil Ossuary
locations.description: An abandoned sanctuary beyond the forest holds sealed research and the memories of its former keepers. Licensed expeditions may study its ancestral records; disturbing remains without consent invites scrutiny. Visitors leave pebbles on the sill. The oldest pile has been arranged into a name. Borrowed tools carry the borrower’s name on a scrap of cloth. Current public magic law: licensed; an accusation still requires a local witness or evidence.
locations.localCustom: Borrowed tools carry the borrower’s name on a scrap of cloth.

institutions.name: The Basaltanvil Ossuary Rook Keeper Archive
institutions.history: Surviving keeper records preserve disputed accounts; a catalog entry alone does not establish the truth of a legend.

locations.name: The Basaltspan Teeth
locations.description: Wind-carved passes and abandoned mines cross the northern mountains. Guides keep a refuge beneath the high stones. Children sort the discarded stone into little cairns along the lower path. An absent neighbor keeps a named place at the seasonal meal. Current public magic law: licensed; an accusation still requires a local witness or evidence.

locations.name: The Lanternmarch Reedwaste
locations.description: Lanterns mark a boardwalk through deep reed beds. Apothecaries gather rare remedies beside drowned foundations. On dry mornings, the gatherers can hear their neighbors working beyond the mist. A promise is repeated in the listener’s own words. Current public magic law: licensed; an accusation still requires a local witness or evidence.

locations.name: Cinderhaven Harbor
locations.description: A harbor of salt-white sails, fisher families, and traders from distant provinces. New arrivals bring both opportunity and rumor. Every incoming ship sounds its bell twice. The third ring is reserved for an empty berth. An absent neighbor keeps a named place at the seasonal meal. Current public magic law: licensed; an accusation still requires a local witness or evidence.

institutions.history: Its public record names the households that maintained this place, including neighbors outside the wealthy guilds.

locations.name: Ore forgewatch Observatory
locations.description: A lonely observatory studies the stars and preserves knowledge beyond the city academy’s reach. Its keepers welcome careful learners. Current public magic law: permitted; an accusation still requires a local witness or evidence.

Current public magic law: permitted; an accusation still requires a local witness or evidence.

rooms.title: The cistern keeper

rooms.title: The tainted spring

journal.title: A life begins at birth
journal.text: Sazorin Starjourney was born in Ironhall. The morning brought thin snow.

journal.title: The thread in your blanket
journal.text: Openhand Starjourney folds the thread into the box. By morning, the midwife has forgotten to ask about it.

journal.title: The Edge of Cloth
journal.text: Your fingers close around a fold of cloth. The rough weave, the warmth beneath it and the effort of holding on fill the whole moment.

journal.title: A World of Breathing
journal.text: For now, the world comes as warmth, hunger and the rise and fall of nearby breathing. Beyond it, Ironhall has names you cannot yet know.

journal.title: Before Words
journal.text: A voice repeats the same soft sounds. You do not know the story inside them; you know the pause before the voice begins again.

journal.title: The last warm hour
journal.text: Openhand Starjourney hums until you sleep. Cold air moves behind the cloth all winter.

journal.title: The Small Hours
journal.text: You wake while the world is quiet, then drift away before it has finished waking. The hours belong to bodily needs rather than bells or promises.

journal.title: Steps Beyond Sight
journal.text: Footsteps pass somewhere beyond your view: near, then far, then gone. You turn toward the sound before there is a word for where it went.

journal.title: The Returning Shape
journal.text: A familiar shape leans close, disappears and returns. You cannot count the returns, but your body knows the difference between waiting and being held.

journal.title: The Farther Side of the Year
journal.text: The year has more days behind it than ahead. That fact changes the feeling of a familiar task without changing the task itself.

journal.title: The Secret of Names
journal.text: Places seem more solid after you learn their names. Still, a dark corner remains a dark corner no matter how confidently you call it by an ordinary word.

yearHistory.title: What you leave on the table

yearHistory.title: A room for the next household

yearHistory.title: The craft you still want to learn
yearHistory.summary: Your first attempt does not quite fit. The maker leaves the two pieces beside each other so you can see where they differ.

yearHistory.title: The festival work nobody planned
yearHistory.summary: The patron reads the repair list, then sends someone to fetch more coin. The extra banner is left folded in its box.

yearHistory.title: Your rival’s name beside yours

yearHistory.title: Your friend’s life beside your own
yearHistory.summary: You carry the last box to Voldren Wrenholt’s new door. They leave it closed while showing you the room they chose.

yearHistory.title: Your rival returns with a different account
yearHistory.summary: You compare the source against the older copies. A note about the disagreement is attached before either account is repeated.

yearHistory.title: A warning before the long road
yearHistory.summary: You take work that can be finished locally. The supplies intended for the road stay stacked by your door.

yearHistory.title: The evening your friend had been waiting for
yearHistory.summary: Voldren Wrenholt talks well past the time supper would have begun. You walk home with a story you had never heard from them before.

yearHistory.title: A letter addressed to the person you were
yearHistory.summary: You put the old letter beside an account of the years that followed. The two papers are kept in the same box.

yearHistory.title: A commission with an unnamed buyer
yearHistory.summary: You turn both commissions away and finish a piece you had been putting aside. The bench is clear before supper.
